title: FBI Arrests Founder of Ransomware Negotiation Firm
contentSnippet: Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) on Thursday arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSecurity.

title: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash
contentSnippet: We are expanding the Clef decision model family with Clef-omni, natively processing audio, video, images, and text in a single pipeline. We’ve also lowered Clef-flash pricing and boosted Clef inference speeds by up to 2.0x.

title: Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build
contentSnippet:
The barriers to building software have collapsed. Today, anyone can build. Hackathons are a great place to start learning.

title: Introducing on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs for Workers and Durable Objects
contentSnippet: On-demand CPU and memory profiling for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects is now available. Now you can generate interactive flamegraphs directly in production to quickly track down memory leaks and performance bottlenecks.

title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
contentSnippet: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.
